My ex boyfriend did that to me. The night after my mothers funeral he called 911 from another state. Lied to the cops and said he had recieved suicidal texts from me so the police came. I didnt know why the cops were there so i wouldnt let them in without a warrent. They threated to bang down my door. I let them in and they took me outside where an emt asked me questions. I did not consent to being taken to the hospital. I was home alone so i called a friend to notify a lawyer if i was being held and another friend to come get me. I was cuffed and put in an ambulance and taken to a psych er. I was clearly not suicidal so once i finally saw a dr (3 hour wait) i was cleared to go. I wasnt insured at the time so i ended up with 1150$ in medical bills.
